findings.statement: TNFa pathway activity at baseline is higher in non-responders to ustekinumab (t [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.t_nr_vs_r=4.79]), but also in UNIFI placebo non-responders (t [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).t_nr_vs_r=3.5]), so it largely marks severity rather than a drug mechanism.

The TNFa signal does not replicate in every placebo arm: PURSUIT placebo shows BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (PURSUIT).padj=0.932]. In PROTECT it is associated with non-response to corticosteroids (t [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.corticosteroids (PROTECT).t_nr_vs_r=3.62]) but not with the aminosalicylate arm (BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.5-ASA (PROTECT).padj=0.414]).

JAK-STAT activity is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0124]) but not in vedolizumab non-responders (BH padj [type=response_pathway; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.vedolizumab.padj=0.571]); the UNIFI placebo arm is borderline, so a drug-specific reading is not established.

OSM is higher at baseline in ustekinumab non-responders (difference [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.diff_nr_minus_r=0.651], BH padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.0000264]); UNIFI placebo is not significant (BH padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.116]), but the drug-versus-placebo interaction is not significant either, so drug specificity is not shown.

OSM does not separate golimumab responders (BH padj [gene=OSM; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.golimumab.padj=0.994]), and no significant cell-state difference was found in the adalimumab single-cell atlas; the signal is limited to ustekinumab and corticosteroid arms.

TREM1 is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (difference [gene=TREM1; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.diff_nr_minus_r=0.826]) but also in UNIFI placebo non-responders (BH padj [gene=TREM1; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0234]), so it looks like a severity marker.

CXCL8 is higher in ustekinumab non-responders (difference [gene=CXCL8; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.diff_nr_minus_r=1.115]) and in UNIFI placebo non-responders (BH padj [gene=CXCL8; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0154]), i.e. severity rather than a drug mechanism; no other anti-TNF or vedolizumab arm survives correction.

In the adalimumab atlas (GSE282122, a small cohort), CXCL8 shows no baseline difference between remitters and non-remitters, but falls in cycling mononuclear phagocytes after treatment (coef [gene=CXCL8; type=antitnf_singlecell; source=DATASET:GSE282122; after_vs_before_treatment.1.coef=-1.377]); a lead only.

CXCR2 is the top convergence candidate (many evidence streams, clinical-stage antagonists) but its baseline association with ustekinumab non-response is matched in UNIFI placebo (BH padj [gene=CXCR2; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.placebo (UNIFI).padj=0.0126]) and the ustekinumab-versus-placebo interaction is null (BH padj [gene=CXCR2; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; interaction.ustekinumab.padj=0.981]): a severity signal, not drug-specific.

IL23A, the ustekinumab-related target, shows no association with ustekinumab outcome (BH padj [gene=IL23A; type=treatment_response; source=ANALYSIS:treatment; arms.ustekinumab.padj=0.977]): baseline target expression does not separate responders.

CHRDL2 is a first-in-class candidate, stromal (inflammatory fibroblasts) and replicated in Garrido-Trigo 2023, Gubatan 2026 and GSE282122, but only a minority of its increase survives composition correction (retained [gene=CHRDL2; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.2764]); highest vital-organ RNA is [gene=CHRDL2; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; vital_max_ntpm=42.6] nTPM, the highest among the strongest candidates, a safety question.

CPXM1 is a stromal fibroblast gene replicated in Garrido-Trigo 2023 and GSE282122 (Gubatan 2026 calls it epithelial), with low vital-organ RNA ([gene=CPXM1; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; vital_max_ntpm=9.1] nTPM); it is partly composition-driven and has no drug-response evidence.

GLT1D1 is classified as composition: neutrophil share of its inflamed transcripts is [gene=GLT1D1; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; neutrophil_share=0.891], so the increase reflects infiltrating neutrophils, not a change of the tissue itself, despite replication across Garrido-Trigo 2023, Gubatan 2026 and GSE282122.

XKR9 is the one top candidate with an intrinsic epithelial signal (retained [gene=XKR9; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.7976]), replicated in Gubatan 2026 and GSE282122, but it is up in only a few cohorts (count [gene=XKR9; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; cohorts_up=4]) and with low expression in few cells.

LAX1 is expressed in plasma and T cells, a lineage call that is not replicated (only one of the three other atlases agrees with Smillie 2019), and only a minority of its signal is retained after composition correction ([gene=LAX1; type=discovery_profile; source=ANALYSIS:discovery; retained=0.23]); it likely reflects immune infiltration.

caveats: All associations are baseline and observational; no drug-specific signal survives a significant drug-versus-placebo interaction for OSM, TREM1, CXCL8 or CXCR2.
Infliximab, vedolizumab, golimumab and ACT1 arms have small non-responder or responder groups, so null results there are underpowered.
The adalimumab single-cell atlas is small; leads only.
Discovery candidates are mostly partly composition-driven and lack functional or genetic validation; PROTECT is a paediatric cohort with different endpoints.
